subject: BlueLatch: throughput & error spike — RCA packet, owners, exec checklist
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@bluelatch.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@bluelatch.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 14:34:00 +0000
Subject: Major spike — 9/3 02:00UTC — service errors and retries

Hey Dylan,

We saw a sharp throughput collapse starting ~02:00 UTC this morning and a corresponding spike in 5xx errors and client retries. Our storefront experienced ~27% failed requests for ~18 minutes; we’re getting paged by our SREs and product owners.

Attached are our log snippets and a Grafana snapshot (errors by endpoint + token latencies). Can you confirm whether this was an internal rollout, routing change, or something else? We need an exec-level response and an ETA for mitigation.

What we need from Redwood: immediate mitigation steps you took, root cause hypothesis, and a list of owners/commits you’ll make and when. We’ll need an exec readout later today.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Ops, BlueLatch
BlueLatch Inc.

Attachments: bluelatch-logs-0903.txt (text), grafana-errors-0903.png (image)
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@bluelatch.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Major spike — 9/3 02:00UTC — service errors and retries

Samira —

Thanks for the alert and the attachments. We’re on it. Quick summary of immediate steps taken:
- Opened an incident bridge and pinned the request routing to the previous model variant (rollback of canary) to reduce tokenization/decoder failures.
- Applied a temporary rate cap on long-running streaming calls that were backpressuring the queue.
- Flushed KV caches across the serving pool to avoid stale state causing retry storms.

I’m looping in Kimberly (runtime) and Jonas (customer success / exec liaison). We’ll produce a short RCA packet and an action tracker within ~8 hours and share an exec checklist for your stakeholders.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min triage bridge (now) — operations + BlueLatch 
2) 4-hour mitigation logged and owner assignment
3) Exec readout at 18:00 UTC if that works for your team — slot open for 30 minutes

—Dylan

Folks —

Follow-up from the triage bridge: root cause (interim hypothesis) is an unfavorable combination of a recent model tokenizer change + KV-cache eviction timing that caused higher average decode latency for certain long-prompt paths. That increased per-request GPU time and caused queue buildup on a subset of serving hosts leading to timeouts upstream.

Immediate actions done (log entries attached):
- Rolled back tokenizer remap introduced in release r2027.8.12 to reduce per-token processing cost (rollback confirmed at 15:05 UTC).
- Applied a short-term concurrency cap on the affected GPU pool; scaled up two spare instances to absorb burst traffic.
- Cleaned a small set of corrupted cache entries that were producing repeated retried requests.

Next deliverables (this message is the 3-hour update):
- RCA packet draft (rca_packet_v1.pdf) — Kim to own (delivery by EOD).
- Action tracker spreadsheet (action_tracker_bluelatch.xlsx) — includes owners, deadlines, and verification steps (shared now).
- Exec checklist (one-pager) with mitigation timeline for BlueLatch execs — Dylan will draft and circulate.

I’ll attach the metrics snapshot and key logs to the RCA.

-Kim
Runtime Lead, Serving
Redwood Inference

Attachments: metrics-snapshot-20270903.png (image), rca_log_snippets.txt (text)
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Team —

Attached is the initial RCA packet (rca_packet_v1.pdf) and the action tracker (action_tracker_bluelatch.xlsx). Below is an exec-friendly summary and the commitments we are making. Please review and surface any questions ahead of the 18:00 UTC readout.

Executive summary (2 bullets):
- What happened: A tokenizer remap change combined with delayed KV-cache eviction created significantly longer decode times on ~18% of requests. This caused queue growth and upstream timeouts for BlueLatch endpoints for ~18 minutes starting 02:00 UTC.
- Impact: Peak failed requests ~27% for affected endpoints; overall request latency doubled for the impacted cohort.

Committed corrective actions (owner — ETA — verification):
- Formal rollback confirmation and automated rollout gating added to CI: kimberly_park — 2027-09-07T18:00:00Z — verified by canary pass and audit log.
- KV eviction scheduler guardrails to avoid correlated cache churn: kimberly_park — 2027-09-10T23:59:00Z — verified by synthetic load test.
- Add per-customer early detection alerts (latency & 5xx rate thresholds): dylan_brooks — 2027-09-09T12:00:00Z — verified via alert firing on test traffic.
- Credits & goodwill review for BlueLatch (commercial): jonas_weber — 2027-09-08T17:00:00Z — confirmed in customer billing system.

Escalation / exec checklist for BlueLatch meeting:
- Who (Redwood exec): Jonas Weber (CS lead), Marissa Cole (SRE liaison), Dylan Brooks (incident owner)
- What to show: RCA packet highlight slide, action tracker snapshot, immediate mitigations done, timeline of events, and planned verification steps.
- Ask of BlueLatch: confirm acceptable time for verification window (we propose 72 hours of observation once KV guardrails are live).

Samira — please confirm whether 18:00 UTC still works and if the readout should include any BlueLatch execs beyond your ops and product leads.

Regards,
Dylan
